crossCuttingFindings.summary: Two shipped destinations contain several competing internal navigation models.
Large stateful widgets own navigation, runtime data, errors, and context together.
Test, diagnostic, evidence, certification, capability, platform, and release states lack one user-facing separation contract.
Baseline Material semantics exist, but global focus, selection, blocked-state, and reopen behavior are not specified.
Selected project and run context can be reset or obscured when moving among internal views.
